item.title: Word of the Day: Fiduciary
item.description: Phonetic: /fuh-DOO-shee-air-ee/ Part of Speech: Adjective Definition Fiduciary is a formal word describing something relating to or involving trust, such as the trust between a customer and a professional. The bank’s fiduciary obligations are clearly stated in the contract.
